title: Dialectica Marks 10th Anniversary: $100M+ Revenue, 1,400 Employees, 70% CAGR
summary: Dialectica celebrated its 10th anniversary having grown to $100M+ annual revenue, 1,400 employees across six offices on three continents, and a 70% CAGR — the highest in the expert network industry. The firm has invested over $25M in technology with 100+ engineers and serves 70,000+ clients across 165 countries.
whyItMatters: A decade of growth from Athens startup to global expert network illustrates the industry's expansion opportunity.
